summary: Iteration 9 - Comprehensive testing of OTA iCal Sync feature. Fixed iCal parsing bug in mock data generator. All core features working: OTA Settings page, feeds CRUD, single 'Sync from OTA' button, background sync processing, OTA source badges on bookings. Backend tests: 17/21 passed (2 failed due to intermittent 520 server error during test, 2 skipped). Frontend UI tests: All passed.

minor.issue: Intermittent 520 errors during high-frequency requests (Cloudflare timeout). Not reproducible in normal usage.
FIXED - Original mock iCal generator had incorrect line endings causing 'DTSTART does not have a parent component' parsing error. Fixed by using proper CRLF line endings per RFC 5545.

issues: Minor accessibility warning: Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby` for DialogContent

critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: Mock iCal generator was using Python multiline f-strings which don't produce proper CRLF line endings. Fixed to use explicit '\r\n' as per RFC 5545 iCal specification.

Duplicate detection works by UID or (property_id + check_in + check_out + ota_source exists), but mock data regenerates UIDs each time - this is expected for mock data, real iCal feeds have consistent UIDs.
Properties page correctly shows last_ota_sync_at timestamp which is updated after successful sync.
OTA feeds are company-scoped and admin-only access is enforced.

seed_data_creation: Created test admin user (ota.admin.{ts}@example.com) with company and 2 properties (Beach House, Mountain Cabin). Created 3 OTA feeds (Booking.com, VRBO, Expedia). Synced 23 bookings from mock iCal data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 9 verified full OTA iCal sync feature: (1) OTA Settings page for managing iCal feeds CRUD, (2) Single 'Sync from OTA' button on Properties page triggers background sync, (3) Sync fetches mock://source/PropertyName URLs and parses iCal VEVENT data, (4) Bookings are created with ota_source, ota_external_id, ota_feed_id fields, (5) Bookings page displays OTA source badges, (6) Properties show last sync timestamp. Mock URLs format: mock://airbnb/PropertyName. The iCal parser uses icalendar library. Fixed iCal line ending bug in mock generator.
